name: EuroMillions
description: EuroMillions is a transnational lottery requiring players to select five main numbers from 1 to 50 and two additional 'Lucky Star' numbers from 1 to 12. Draws are held twice a week, on Tuesdays and Fridays, with jackpots starting at €17 million and rolling over if not won. The game is known for its large jackpots and multiple prize tiers, making it popular across participating European countries.

name: Lotto 6/49
description: Lotto 6/49 is a popular Canadian lottery game where players select six numbers from a pool of 49. Draws are held twice a week, on Wednesdays and Saturdays. The game offers a guaranteed jackpot of at least $5 million, which can roll over if not won. In addition to the jackpot, there are multiple prize tiers for matching fewer numbers, making it a favorite among lottery enthusiasts in Canada.

name: Lotto 6/45

Lotto 6/45 is known for its straightforward format and is enjoyed by many lottery enthusiasts in Austria.

name: Powerball (US)
description: Powerball is a widely popular lottery game in the United States, known for its massive jackpots that can reach hundreds of millions of dollars. Players select five main numbers from a pool of 69 and one Powerball number from a separate pool of 26. Draws are held twice a week, on Wednesdays and Saturdays. The game offers multiple prize tiers, with the jackpot starting at $20 million and rolling over if not won.
